title: Endgame status + buy
description: Orchestrator atom: panel status → game-over gate → gem_box_check → buy_health → buy_damage → leave Attack open. Child atoms via run_event.
notes: Enabled for Endgame Phase Loop. Composes gem_box_check / buy_health / buy_damage. Keep humanize_upgrade_loop disabled.

actions.description: Observe the screen first: is the upgrade panel open, and which tab?
Echo the panel status into the Automations console.
Read the front-center dialog region and infer GAME_OVER vs RUNNING.
If the run ended, stop. Otherwise gem-check + Health→Damage buys.
actions.explain_a: run is over — log it and skip buys
actions.explain_b: run active — gem check, Health buy, Damage buy, leave Attack open

on_a.name: game_over
on_a.description: Mark game_over for stats CSV / stop_when.

on_b.message: buy path: Defense/Health then Attack/Damage (menus stay open)

on_b.description: Final status check — confirm Attack is still open.

on_b.message: left panel open: tab={upgrade_tab} (human convenience — no close tap)
on_b.description: Confirm we did not close the upgrade menu.
